questions.stem: Which starting-zone quest item teaches Mining?
questions.explanation: Mining for Dummies teaches Mining and gives +2 skill. Wild Harvest teaches Herbalism, and Pelt Collecting for Beginners teaches Skinning.

questions.stem: At what Mining skill can you make Azerothium Bars?
questions.explanation: Azerothium Bar is made from Pitchblende and Coal at Mining 275. Skill 140 and 300 are where the Rock Garden and the Molten Foundry unlock.

questions.stem: Where are Heavy Thorium Bars smelted?
questions.explanation: Heavy Thorium Bar is smelted at a Molten Foundry, the Mining camp object that unlocks at skill 300.

questions.stem: Who drops the Rock Garden blueprint?
questions.explanation: The Relic Guardian in the Excavation Site: Wetlands drops the Rock Garden blueprint. Shadetooth drops the Herbalism Greenhouse and Lady Anacondra the Skinning Field Guide.

questions.stem: Up to what skill does Journeyman Mining go?
questions.explanation: Apprentice goes up to 75, Journeyman to 150, Expert to 225 and Artisan to 300.

questions.stem: Your group has no Paladin. Which Mining camp object gives a buff that matches Blessing of Might?
questions.explanation: The Lodestone's buff matches Blessing of Might and does not stack with it, so it helps most in groups without a Paladin.

questions.stem: Which scarce ore goes into Azerothium Bars?
questions.explanation: Azerothium Bar is made from Pitchblende and Coal. Pyrite and Bauxite are the other new scarce yields.
